about.title: About
about.description: I'm Nam Nguyen, a designer since 2019 and now Design Leader at Ngoc Dung Beauty Center, where I have led 20 campaigns this year, from concept and key visual to social, print and in-store rollout. Before that I designed for Seedcom (Juno, Hnoss), the real-estate brands LinkHouse and Maple Land, and the beauty brands Tu Trinh Spa and Zema. Every project starts from a clear idea and ends in work that feels precise and memorable.

projects.title: FROM BRIEF TO KEY VISUAL IN ONE DAY
projects.description: How I combine AI image tools with classic retouching to move from a campaign brief to an approved key visual in a single working day.

blocks.label: 01 / The brief
blocks.text: Every key visual starts with one sentence: what should the customer feel in the first second? I write it down before opening any tool, because AI is fast but it cannot decide the idea for you.

blocks.x1: Collect references, lock the palette, the light and the pose.
blocks.x2: Generate scenes and props with AI, then keep only the frames that serve the idea.
blocks.x3: Magnific for detail, Photoshop for skin and product, then the final layout and copy.

blocks.text: AI speeds up the making. The idea still has to come first.

projects.title: MAGNIFIC FOR BEAUTY VISUALS
projects.description: Before and after: how I use Magnific to bring back skin, hair and product detail without losing the natural look a beauty brand needs.

blocks.label: Before / After
blocks.text: Low-resolution or generated images often look soft. Magnific rebuilds texture, but too much creativity changes the face. I keep it low on people and push it higher on products and backgrounds.
Sharper is not the goal. Believable is.

projects.title: HIGGSFIELD: FROM STILL TO MOTION
projects.description: Turning one approved key visual into short motion pieces for Reels and TikTok, without a new shoot.

blocks.label: One visual, many formats
blocks.text: A campaign needs the same idea on every screen. With Higgsfield I add camera moves and small motion to the key visual, then cut 5 to 10 second clips for social.
Motion makes people stop. The key visual makes them remember.

projects.title: AI RULES FOR A BEAUTY BRAND
projects.description: The rules my team follows so AI helps the brand instead of putting its trust at risk.

blocks.x1: Models and customers keep their own faces. AI never changes who someone is.
blocks.x2: Before and after images of treatments are always real photos, never generated.
blocks.x3: Colours, logo and tone follow the brand guide, and every visual is reviewed before it goes live.

blocks.text: Use AI for the scene, never for the promise.

projects.title: BEHIND A SUMMER KEY VISUAL
projects.description: From the first sketch to the final rollout of the "Thay sắc đón hè" campaign for Ngoc Dung Beauty Center.

blocks.label: 01 / The idea
blocks.text: Summer, travel and a fresh new look: the brief asked for energy without losing the premium feel of the brand.

blocks.label: 02 / Exploring with AI
blocks.text: AI helped me test several backgrounds and light setups in an hour, so the team could choose a direction before any production started.
One idea, carried from the first sketch to every branch.

projects.title: LEADING 20 CAMPAIGNS IN A YEAR
projects.description: What I learned leading the design team at Ngoc Dung Beauty Center through 20 campaigns in 2026.

blocks.x1: One master file per campaign, so every format starts from the same system.
blocks.x2: Fixed review steps keep feedback short and the deadline safe.
blocks.x3: Each designer owns part of a campaign and learns the AI workflow on real work.

blocks.text: A good system lets a team move fast without losing the brand.
